sentences.text: Questioning the jurisdiction of the Tribunal to try the claim petition in M.C.O.P. 79 of 2022, the Manager, the Acko General Insurance Company Limited has filed the present appeal.

2. Heard Mr.B.Siva Kollapan, learned counsel appearing for the appellant and Mr.R.Navaneetha Krishnan, learned counsel appearing for the respondents 1 and 2.
3.

The only point urged in the present appeal filed by the appellant, the Acko General Insurance Company Limited, is that the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Tiruvallur, does not have jurisdiction since the claimants and the Insurance Company are located in the state of Andhra Pradesh.
In this regard, the Insurance Company had already filed an application in I.A.No.2/2023 to decide the point of jurisdiction as a preliminary issue.

The said petition was dismissed by the Tribunal on m e r i t s , v i d e i t s o r d e r s d a t e d 1 7 . 0 3 . 2 0 2 3 , w h i c h h a s n o t b e e n c h a l l e n g e d https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis by way of filing an appeal / revision.
In the circumstances, the present appeal, based on the question of jurisdiction, cannot be sustained.
4. In the result, i. The Civil Miscellaneous Appeal is dismissed.
No costs.
Consequently, connected Civil Miscellaneous Petition is closed.
ii. The Award dated 01.08.2023 in M.C.O.P. 79 of 2022 on the file of the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Special District Court No.1, Tiruvallur, is upheld.
